name: ESOI Applied to AI Behaviour
description: Makes an AI agent apply the principles in its own work, and shows by measurement which way of giving it the principles works.
purpose: Make an AI agent act by the evolvable-structure principles when designing, building, writing and advising.
approach: Give the agent the principles in a chosen form and measure, case by case, whether its replies act on them compared with the same agent without them.
out_of_scope: Teaching people; finding which records or standards bear on a task; general agent ability.
milestones: 1. Behaviour adherence: a recorded run of each arm that calls a model, on the staged sample.
knowledge: The author's skill and its principles, especially principle 4 (humans need only review metrics, not implementations, though they can still add value to implementations) and principle 7 (perspectives are implementations); evaluation practice for language models (cases with an expected behaviour and a failure mode, staged samples, a no-instructions baseline); practice for loading skills and standing instructions.
measures_of_success: The share of cases where the agent's reply acts by the principle, per principle, compared with the same agent without the instructions, with restraint and kept-qualifier cases counted as often as build cases. Standing conditions: Cases cover every principle, including cases where the right behaviour is to hold back or to keep a qualifier; each way of giving the agent the principles is measured on the same cases; the instructions in use are the measured winner or a declared tie; the closing summary of every use says how the principles were applied.
parameters: The model, the way the principles are given (standing instructions, on request, none), the case subset and a call budget.
inputs: A task prompt an agent might be sent.
outputs: The agent's reply and, for a judged run, a verdict with a reason.
effects: A live measurement calls a model and costs money; nothing else.
usage_notes: Run the offline checks after changing the cases or esoi.understanding.esoi_for_ai.behaviour (the reference_good and reference_bad arms need no model); run an arm that calls a model only when a decision depends on it and the spend is approved (esoi/metric-run-policy.md). A person who corrects an agent's behaviour adds or edits a case, not only the instructions, so the correction is measured from then on.
